reference_implementation_a.sql: SELECT provider_id,DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount DESC,provider_id) AS amount_rank FROM (SELECT e.provider_id,SUM(c.amount) AS total_amount FROM encounters e JOIN procedures p ON p.encounter_id=e.encounter_id JOIN charges c ON c.procedure_id=p.procedure_id WHERE c.status='posted' GROUP BY e.provider_id) q ORDER BY amount_rank,provider_id
